def components(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for da,db in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<R and 0<=y<C and (x,y) not in seen and grid[x][y]==color:
                        seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    return bg,comps

def transform(grid):
    bg, comps=components(grid)
    normalized=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[x for x,y in cells]; cs=[y for x,y in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        shape=[[bg]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
        for r,c in cells: shape[r-r0][c-c0]=color
        normalized.append((color,cells,shape))
    for ci,(color,cells,canvas) in enumerate(normalized):
        H,W=len(canvas),len(canvas[0])
        others=[x for i,x in enumerate(normalized) if i!=ci and len(x[2])<=H and len(x[2][0])<=W]
        target=sum(v==bg for row in canvas for v in row)
        if not target: continue
        # recursively pack any other objects, no rotations, until every cavity cell covered
        def search(used, current, covered):
            if covered==target: return [row[:] for row in current]
            if used==(1<<len(others))-1: return None
            for j,(co,ce,sh) in enumerate(others):
                if used>>j&1: continue
                h,w=len(sh),len(sh[0]); n=sum(v!=bg for row in sh for v in row)
                if covered+n>target: continue
                for r in range(H-h+1):
                    for c in range(W-w+1):
                        coords=[(r+a,c+b,v) for a,row in enumerate(sh) for b,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
                        if all(current[x][y]==bg for x,y,v in coords):
                            nxt=[row[:] for row in current]
                            for x,y,v in coords:nxt[x][y]=v
                            ans=search(used|1<<j,nxt,covered+n)
                            if ans is not None:return ans
            return None
        ans=search(0,[row[:] for row in canvas],0)
        if ans is not None:return ans
    raise ValueError('no packing')

def transform(grid):
    bg, comps=components(grid)
    normalized=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[x for x,y in cells]; cs=[y for x,y in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        shape=[[bg]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
        for r,c in cells: shape[r-r0][c-c0]=color
        normalized.append((color,cells,shape))
    for ci,(color,cells,canvas) in enumerate(normalized):
        H,W=len(canvas),len(canvas[0])
        # Find background cavities in the candidate's bounding box.
        unseen={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if canvas[r][c]==bg}
        cavities=[]
        while unseen:
            seed=unseen.pop(); stack=[seed]; region=[seed]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop()
                for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                    p=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if p in unseen: unseen.remove(p);stack.append(p);region.append(p)
            cavities.append(region)
        if not cavities: continue
        others=[x for i,x in enumerate(normalized) if i!=ci]
        def fits(region,sh):
            rs=[r for r,c in region];cs=[c for r,c in region]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1; sh_h,sh_w=len(sh),len(sh[0])
            if h%sh_h or w%sh_w:return None
            sy,sx=h//sh_h,w//sh_w
            stretched={(r0+a*sy+dy,c0+b*sx+dx) for a,row in enumerate(sh) for b,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg for dy in range(sy) for dx in range(sx)}
            return (r0,c0,sy,sx) if stretched==set(region) else None
        def search(k,used,result):
            if k==len(cavities):return result
            region=cavities[k]
            for j,(co,ce,sh) in enumerate(others):
                if used>>j&1:continue
                placement=fits(region,sh)
                if placement is None:continue
                r0,c0,sy,sx=placement; nxt=[row[:] for row in result]
                for a,row in enumerate(sh):
                    for b,v in enumerate(row):
                        if v!=bg:
                            for dy in range(sy):
                                for dx in range(sx):nxt[r0+a*sy+dy][c0+b*sx+dx]=v
                ans=search(k+1,used|1<<j,nxt)
                if ans is not None:return ans
            return None
        ans=search(0,0,[row[:] for row in canvas])
        if ans is not None:return ans
    raise ValueError('no packing')
